FX-PFILT-001.says: The settings as they start: Warming Filter (85), density 25, preserve luminosity on: every colour a little warmer, its brightness kept; black stays black, white turns a pale warm white.

FX-PFILT-002.says: The same with preserve luminosity off: warmer and a little darker, since the orange glass holds back some of the green and blue.

FX-PFILT-003.says: Density 100, preserve luminosity on: the full filter, the brightness kept; pure blue, which the orange glass stops entirely, goes black.

FX-PFILT-004.says: Density 100, preserve luminosity off: each channel multiplied by the filter's colour, white becomes the filter's orange itself.

FX-PFILT-005.says: Density 0: no filter, the drawing exactly as it is.

FX-PFILT-006.says: Warming Filter (81), density 50: a yellower warming.

FX-PFILT-007.says: Cooling Filter (80), density 50: everything bluer, the brightness kept.

FX-PFILT-008.says: Cooling Filter (82), density 50: a paler, cyan cooling.

FX-PFILT-009.says: Sepia, density 60: a brown tint, the brightness kept.

FX-PFILT-010.says: Underwater, density 60: a green-blue tint, the reds pulled down.

FX-PFILT-011.says: Custom magenta #ff00ff, density 50, preserve luminosity off: the green channel halved, red and blue kept.

FX-PFILT-012.says: Warming Filter (85) with the colour set to magenta: the colour is used only for a custom filter, so the same as FX-PFILT-001.

FX-PFILT-013.says: Density keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear, preserve luminosity off: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 halfway, frame 4 the full filter as FX-PFILT-004.

FX-PFILT-014.says: FX-PFILT-011 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-PFILT-015.says: Density -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PFILT-016.says: Density 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PFILT-017.says: Filter "warming", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PFILT-018.says: Filter "Warming_85": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PFILT-019.says: Color "#fff", which is not #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PFILT-020.says: Preserve luminosity "yes", which is not "on" or "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
